chapter: Country years in St. John Parish
title: New Orleans bands hired for society banquets
summary: Country societies hired New Orleans bands such as Kid Howard and Jack Carey only for the annual banquet.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Dance halls, lake resorts and where bands played

blocks.x: Yeah. Well, did you hear many New Orleans bands in the country?
Well, when they had a big to do, what they call a banque for the society.
They get a band and this is like a rainy. Okay. Mm-hmm. Mm-hmm. Mm-hmm. Mm-hmm.

Kid Howard, Jack Carey, all bands like that. They get a different band just for that day. They call that a bonké. They start on Saturday. Free eating and dance and everything out there for the society. That's the only time they get a New Orleans band.
Did those fellows help you any or did you mostly learn from country fellows?
They just heard that from country fellow.
Yes, of course, I learned a whole lot is when I come to the city.
